guze.definition:
n. A roundlet of tincture sanguine, which is blazoned without
   mention of the tincture.

guzman.translation: n. 古斯曼, 古兹曼（西班牙姓氏）

guzzle.definition: v. drink greedily or as if with great thirst
guzzle.translation: v. 狂饮, 暴食, 喝酒化掉(钱)

guzzled.translation: v. 狂吃暴饮, 大吃大喝( guzzle的过去式和过去分词 )

guzzler.definition: n. someone who drinks heavily (especially alcoholic beverages)
guzzler.translation: n. 酒鬼, 酒量大的人

guzzlers.definition:
plural of guzzler
n. someone who drinks heavily (especially alcoholic beverages)
guzzlers.translation: (guzzler 的复数) n. 酒鬼, 酒量大的人

guzzles.definition: v drink greedily or as if with great thirst
guzzles.translation: v. 狂吃暴饮, 大吃大喝( guzzle的第三人称单数 )

guzzling.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Guzzle
guzzling.translation: v. 狂吃暴饮, 大吃大喝( guzzle的现在分词 )
